connection.offlineDetail: You are offline. Nothing you enter here will be lost, but it will not reach the clinic record until the connection returns.

login.subtitle: DTHC clinic staff only.
login.offlineTitle: The clinic server cannot be reached
login.offlineBody: Check the network connection and try again. Nothing was sent.
login.unexpected: Sign-in did not complete. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the administrator.

queue.subtitle: Patients waiting at this station, in order.
queue.emptyDetail: When registration opens a visit, patients appear here in queue order.

placeholder.title: {screen} is not built yet
placeholder.body: This screen exists so the shell can be navigated and reviewed. It lands at {checkpoint}.

secondFactor.codeHint: The six digits your app shows now.
secondFactor.recoveryHint: One of the codes you saved when you set up the authenticator. It works once.
secondFactor.loginBody: Your password was accepted. Now the code from your authenticator app.

device.enrolledBody: Every request this tablet makes is signed with a key that has never left it. Values entered here are attributed to it.
device.forgetHint: Only if an administrator asks. The tablet will need a new code to write anything.
device.notEnrolledBody: This tablet can sign a person in, but it cannot record clinical values until an administrator enrols it. Ask for a code from the device screen of the admin console; it works for fifteen minutes.
device.codeHint: Ten characters, as shown on the administrator's screen. Case and dashes do not matter.
device.refused: The code was not accepted. It may have expired or been used; ask for a new one.
device.offline: The clinic server cannot be reached. Nothing was changed.
device.unexpected: Enrolment did not complete. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the administrator.
device.done: Enrolled. This tablet can now record values.
